AI Overview
Soccer Random (often referred to as football random) is a fun, physics-based HTML5 sports game developed by TD2TL / RHM Interactive and hosted on platforms like TwoPlayerGames. 
How to Play
Objective: Score 5 goals against your opponent to win the match. 
Controls:
In 1-player mode, you play against the computer.
In 2-player mode, both players share a keyboard or touch screen (Player 1 uses the Up arrow, Player 2 uses W or specific key bindings like A/D and J/L depending on the portal).
A single button controls both players on your team at the same time, making them jump and kick. 
Key Features
Wildly Changing Conditions: After every single goal, the game randomly shifts the environment. You might play on an icy field, a sunny beach, or a night stadium. 
Unpredictable Equipment & Characters: The ball can change into a giant ball, a small ball, or even an American football. Character looks and goal post sizes also transform each round. 
No Download Required: You can play it directly in your web browser for free.
